A '''troop squadron''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] commanded by an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]]. The troop squadron was comprised of two [[troop line]]s, an [[attack line]], and a [[skirmish line]], for a force of vessels numbering between twenty-five to thirty. Troop squadrons were generally used as a transfer point to reorganize [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] units within the fleet. These transfers often occurred in deep [[Realspace/Legends|space]] away from potential enemies.
